summary: Completed backend and frontend Gemini 3.8 Flash regression testing on public preview URL. Verified allow-list/defaults, retired-model read-time migration, mocked rewrite model usage, and Integrations selector single-option behavior.
action_items: No functional defects found in requested Gemini 3.8 migration scope.
Keep Gemini provider interactions MOCKED in automated tests; do not add real provider calls or real Gemini key usage.
Optional maintainability: split /app/backend/server.py into smaller modules (file size risk).
critical_code_review_comments: Gemini settings model allow-list/default are constrained to gemini-3.8-flash in backend model + UI selector.
Read-time migration path in _get_gemini_settings correctly replaces retired model values with gemini-3.8-flash and persists the update.
Rewrite stream test confirms saved model gemini-3.8-flash is used through LlmChat.with_model('gemini', model) under MOCKED flow.
No Gemini provider endpoint call was triggered in executed UI path; only static Google Fonts requests were observed from frontend assets.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (Gemini Integrations selector/default and visibility checks passed)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 73 reran focused Gemini backend suites and UI checks. Public-endpoint auth/session checks passed; Integrations > Gemini model dropdown has exactly one option and selected value gemini-3.8-flash. No real Gemini key was saved or used.
rca of the issue: No issue reproduced. Prior risk came from retired Gemini 2.x values causing model mismatch; current implementation mitigates via strict allow-list + read-time migration fallback to gemini-3.8-flash.
